svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: MonedaSegura: entity-relationship diagram
svg.desc: Fifteen decision-service tables: RBAC access (app_user, role, permission, user_role, role_permission), customers and events (customer, device, session_event, transaction), decision and model (decision, model_version, decision_rule_hit), rules (rule, rule_version) and cases (fraud_case).
svg.text: Each box is a PostgreSQL table; each line is a relationship. Access uses RBAC: user → role → permission.
Read from 1 to N. 0..1 means optional: a degraded decision has no model, only REVIEW/BLOCK open a case, and scheduled training has no user.
The line along the bottom and right edges links decision to decision_rule_hit (the relationships form an odd cycle, so one line cannot join neighbors).
